title: Practice 1: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.context: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака.

exercises.why: **за-** — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way — Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The conversation lasted until after midnight.
exercises.context: за- — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way — Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared.

exercises.why: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.. **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: A wasp flew into Tom's mouth.
exercises.context: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst..

exercises.q: Я ___ (заехать / заезжать) за ним в пять.
exercises.why: Автомашина заезжает за дом. (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I'll pick him up at 5.
exercises.context: Автомашина заезжает за дом.

exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The baby crept into the room.
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).
